turnos.plano: Attacking Santarem with all available troops to secure a second village and expand my territory. I built an arqueiro to reinforce my army for next turn. Next turn, I will assess the map from Santarem and plan my next expansion towards Coimbra or Badajoz.

turnos.dep:
Our armies marched on Badajoz today, led by our mighty cavaleiros.
The enemy archers fell before our charge.
In Lisbon, we forged a new cavalry unit to reclaim the neutral lands.
The path to victory is ours to seize.
